techniques.name: Earth: Headhunter
techniques.mechanic: Sink into the ground (hidden 40 ticks), then grab a target's ankles from below: bound 30 ticks, buried to the neck
techniques.counters: jump; earth jutsu of your own; sensing shows where they are

techniques.name: Earth: Mud Wall
techniques.mechanic: A short-lived wall entity 5 wide and 3 high for 160 ticks: blocks projectiles and jutsu that are not lightning
techniques.counters: lightning goes through; go around; Lightning Blade breaks it

techniques.name: Earth: Mud River
techniques.mechanic: The ground turns to a sliding river of mud (10-block cone): knocked down and carried 4 blocks
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Earth: Rock Skin
techniques.mechanic: Harden the skin into stone for 200 ticks (hardened: physical damage taken x0.5, -20% speed); a close fighter's best friend

techniques.name: Earth: Stone Spears
techniques.mechanic: Spikes of stone burst under the target (a 2-block circle, 20 range): launches
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Earth: Earth Dragon Bullet
techniques.mechanic: A dragon of mud rises and spits mud balls (5 x 3 power); a fire ally turns them to lava bullets
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Earth: Flowing Rampart
techniques.mechanic: A great wall 15 wide and 6 high for 300 ticks (hp 200): holds a gate, covers a squad
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Earth: Light-Weight Rock
techniques.mechanic: Touch: make yourself light (+30% speed, double jump) or an enemy heavy (slow 0.5, cannot jump) for 200 ticks
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Earth: Earth Splitting
techniques.mechanic: Slam the ground: a fissure runs 24 blocks (an entity effect; blocks never change), knocking down everything in its path
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall
